Protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir over governance changes

Protests erupted in Pakistan-administered Kashmir against the government's move to grant provincial status to Gilgit-Baltistan. Reports indicate clashes between protesters and security forces, with at least nine people killed and others injured. The United Nations has urged an investigation into the deaths and called for calm ahead of upcoming polls. Pakistan reportedly deployed additional security forces and heavy weaponry to the region amidst the unrest.
